notes.title: Update Roadmap!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey all! [/h2]

It's now been a little over a month since [b]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/b] launched across platforms! I want to take a second to thank you all, everyone who supported the game during [b]Early Access[/b], and beyond [b]1.0[/b] so far! I am so proud of the community we have build together!

In the official Discord alone, we now have over [b]40.000 members[/b] - that's crazy!

Today I want to take some time and share with you my plans for the future of [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b] via a nice little visual [b]roadmap [/b]here.

[h1]The Roadmap[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/aff75adb7bd1d2036ae43bd9c49bd2f3546c631a.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Details[/h1]

This roadmap outlines the core top-level features I plan to bring to [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b] moving forward. Production for Phase 1 already started, with the [b]Replay Editor[/b] having just launched in BETA on Steam yesterday for players to test and share their feedback on! More details about each phase and what it contains in detail will be shared as we move forward in production! Throughout the coming months, you will see new content and features drop on both PC & consoles.

As always, you'll see me regularly hang out in the [b]Discord [/b]to chat with you all, and collect your ideas and feedback! I am super excited for the future of [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b], and hope the [b]roadmap[/b] gets you excited for what's to come moving forward!

[b]See you soon,
Michel (Dev)[/b]

notes.title: Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Everything new in Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/6e617de460ad668d5f5a992c7775e749f7e7721a.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Progression System[/h1]

[b]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/b] features a full solo progression system that lets you unlock new customization items by winning bronze, silver, or gold medals! For each completed challenge (Gold), you get up to 6 feathers. There are [b]300 feathers[/b] to get in total, and over [b]100 customization items to unlock for you and your pigeon![/b] Customization items will unlock automatically once rewards are gained in sufficient amounts. Feathers aren't being spent, but instead held in your progression, so they can be seen as your level status at the same time!

[h1]Progression Overview[/h1]

The new [b]progression overview[/b] [b](Found via the pause menu)[/b] helps you keep track of your overall progression. You can simply browse between challenges and maps, and even select challenges in the map you're currently on, which will then highlight the marker in the world, showing you where you need to head next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/769ed4ebfcb024f6f1e3c4637c980c2974bfd6b2.gif[/img]

[h1]Pigeon Unlocking[/h1]

[b]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/b], you need to [b]unlock the pigeon[/b] in every map. While trained players will do this in no time, new players will be encouraged to traverse around, learning the mechanics as they go, until they find and unlock the pigeon for each map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/3eb215ebc8bf97bb44d81283bb652726974d4471.gif[/img]

[h1]New Challenges[/h1]

Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 has a total of 48 challenges to compete in! The 1.0 received a lot of new Time Trials & Trick Rush challenges across all 6 maps!

[h1]New Map (Container Ship)[/h1]

The [b]Container Ship[/b] alias: [b]The Big Pigeon[/b] offers a dense new environment to challenge yourself in brand-new [b]Time Trials & Trick Rush[/b] challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/02822d657f2a985f348f75326cc1ef5bb3a9ac68.gif[/img]

[h1]Reworked Combo & Scoring System[/h1]

The [b]combo system[/b] has been upgraded to now remember the last tricks you performed, encouraging players to be more creative, while making gaining points a little more challenging and rewarding! Players who repeat the same tricks over and over again will see their individual trick points decrease. To counter that, you can perform a variety of tricks and be more versatile, to allow yourself to get the maximum points possible!

[h1]New Multiplayer Game Mode (Tricks Battle)[/h1]

The brand new [b]Tricks Battle[/b] game mode is great for players wanting to challenge each other in an online match to see who gets the highest score! Players see each other's score live while a timer runs out, putting pressure on everyone involved. Keeping up your combo meter is the key to success in this purely skill-based multiplayer game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/8752a646452b0f9841a7dcb86681fd08c659b770.gif[/img]

[h1]New Physical Sliding Mechanic[/h1]

The sliding mechanic has been reworked from scratch! Before, you had the ability to either slide on flat ground or auto-slide on sloped surfaces. Now, both have been merged into one to create a fully physics-based sliding system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/af6bae25ea2def53c4f2c28ec3a65545dba53e74.gif[/img]

[h1]The Photomode is here![/h1]

[b]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/b] features a brand new super [b]in-depth photomode[/b] to allow players to capture the most creative shots in-game! Adjust settings like depth of field, focus distance, saturation, contrast, gamma, film grain, and choose from a selection of borders, filters, and preset poses! The highlight feature of this brand new photomode is the '[b]Doll Mode[/b]'. This mode allows you to precisely move each body part of your character where you want, creating exactly the poses you are looking for!

[h1]New Music![/h1]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 features [b]20 original in-game soundtracks!

[/b][list][*][p][b] RNA - About Time[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Alibi[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - All I Ever Wanted[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Bodymove[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Bring This To The Streets[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Falling Like Rain[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Floating[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Forever Now[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Limitless[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Lost In Time[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Midnight Echoes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - On A Roll[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Remember Me[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Ride Or Die[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Streetstyle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - The Beginning[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Together[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Underwater[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Urban Escape[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] RNA - Watch Me [/b][/p][/*][/list]

[h1]Achievements are here![/h1]

Finally, Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 now has achievements! Time to go achievement hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/f14d9c25d8e21bcc5eb42b8716660eff5c15b3af.gif[/img]

[h1]Localization (Translation)[/h1]

Rooftops & Alleys 1.0 has been translated into many different languages! Here's the list of new languages added to the game:

[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Czech
[*] Dutch
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish - Latin America
[*] Ukrainian
[/list]
[h1]Note:[/h1]

If you have played the Early Access version, your prior saves will be deleted. This only happens once and is required for the all-new progression system to work properly!

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]

Getting to [b]1.0[/b] was a huge [b]milestone[/b] for me. I can't thank everyone enough for all the support during the Early Access phase in the past year! And now it's finally time for the next chapter of [b]RNA[/b]!

notes.title: 1.0 News!
notes.notes:
As we're approaching the big [b]1.0 release[/b] of [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b] this month, I would like to inform you all about what's coming and what can be expected from the launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/b61a5b2137bf1de73ef2ef9e645727f6ee357c49.png[/img]

First of all [b](To get the least exciting news out first)[/b], there will be the already announced and final price increase on launch day. This price increase reflects the newly added content added to the game  on this 1.0 update. The full game will cost [b]24.99[/b] usd at launch. Of course, no one who currently owns the game is affected by this price increase. 

For now, however, the price will stay as it currently is until the day of launch :)

[b]Now for the exciting parts! [/b]

[h1]1.0 Content overview:[/h1]

Rooftops & Alleys will feature a brand new map, a full solo progression system, +100 customization items to unlock, achievements, a new multiplayer game mode (Tricks Battle), a new physical sliding mechanic, a super in-depth photomode, new time trials and trick rush challenges, multiple languages, and loads of improvements left and right!

[b]Furthermore, any previous saves will be reset on launch. This is due to the all-new progression system coming on the day of release![/b]

[b]Note:[/b] While achievements are already visible on the Steam store page, they will only be activated on launch day! This is mostly for testing purposes on my end, to make sure the game is ready and fully functional for you on the day of launch! 

[b]See you all soon!
Michel (Dev)[/b]

notes.title: #25 - Capture The Flag & More!
notes.notes:
[b]Added new ‘Capture The Flag’ game mode[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/f97e20fd2cdd3045553d67966b57a8c0dbfdc237.jpg[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b] In this game mode, each player's goal is to capture the flag and hold on to it as long as possible.

Should you fall while carrying the flag, you will drop it and have to pick it up again - that is unless someone else steals it from you in the meantime!

Whoever owns the flag by the time the game ends automatically wins. The other players will be ranked based on how long each player had the flag for. If no one has the flag by the time the game ends, everyone will be ranked based on the time they each had the flag for.
